result.summary: The pedestrian environment is poor, featuring a wide unmarked roadway where a pedestrian is seen walking in the travel lane. While a sidewalk exists on one side, it is narrow and lacks a buffer from traffic, and there are no visible marked crossings at the approaching intersection.

result.summary: The image shows a continuous concrete sidewalk separated from the roadway by a curb. The environment is characterized by a long stretch of blank frontage consisting of a concrete barrier and chain-link fence, lacking any pedestrian amenities or buffers.

hazards.name: Lack of street lighting
hazards.description: No visible street lights along this stretch of sidewalk, which can reduce visibility and safety at night.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the entire visible sidewalk length.

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian buffer
hazards.description: The sidewalk is directly adjacent to the roadway with only a curb for separation, offering no physical or psychological buffer from moving vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Edge between the sidewalk and the road surface.

interventions.title: Install Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Add street lamps to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians during nighttime hours.

interventions.title: Implement a Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Introduce a planting strip or furniture zone between the curb and the sidewalk to increase separation from traffic.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment consists of a narrow sidewalk on one side of a newly paved roadway approaching a bridge. The area lacks basic safety infrastructure such as lane markings, marked crossings, and traffic calming measures, which may encourage higher vehicle speeds in an industrial setting.

hazards.name: Lack of lane markings
hazards.description: The freshly paved asphalt lacks lane markings, which can lead to unpredictable vehicle positioning and increased risk for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Absence of pedestrian crossings
hazards.description: There are no marked crossing points for pedestrians to safely navigate across the wide roadway.

hazards.name: Lack of sidewalk buffer
hazards.description: The sidewalk on the left is immediately adjacent to the travel lane without any horizontal separation or buffer.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image along the curb

interventions.title: Roadway Striping
interventions.description: Apply standard lane markings to define travel lanes and organize vehicle flow.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility marked crosswalks at logical crossing points to improve pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer/Barrier
interventions.description: Install a physical barrier or a wider buffer zone between the sidewalk and the roadway, especially on the bridge approach.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by wide, unmarked roadways and inconsistent sidewalk infrastructure. There is a lack of designated crossing points and significant gaps in the paved walkway network, prioritizing vehicle movement over pedestrian safety.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crosswalks
hazards.description: Pedestrians crossing the wide intersection have no designated or protected space, increasing the risk of conflict with vehicles.

hazards.name: Poor sidewalk condition
hazards.description: The sidewalk on the left side of the image is unpaved and uneven, creating a tripping hazard and accessibility barrier.

hazards.name: Wide turning radius
hazards.description: The corner geometry allows for high-speed vehicle turns, endangering pedestrians at the crossing point.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install zebra-striped crosswalks at all legs of the intersection to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions to reduce the crossing distance for pedestrians and slow down turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Paving and Repair
interventions.description: Pave the dirt sections of the walkway to provide a continuous, ADA-compliant pedestrian path.
